title: Vitruvyan Motus ControlApplication, v1
description: ADR-036. Evidence that one declared control was evaluated or applied at one execution-scoped evidence boundary. A valid document reports one control event; it is not a control-effectiveness, certification, conformity, or compliance verdict and cannot elevate an ADR-020 assurance level.

registry_fingerprint.description: Derived fingerprint of the exact Risk & Control Registry revision that declared this control. Validation checks shape; binding verification recomputes the value from the supplied registry.

execution_ref.description: Canonical ADR-027 tenant/writer/sequence locator. CA1 checks its semantic grammar. The locator is not proof that the execution exists.

manifest_fingerprint.description: Optional derived fingerprint of the exact System Manifest revision under which the control event was observed.

enforcement_point.description: Neutral name of the point at which this control event was observed.

outcome.description: Closed neutral event vocabulary. These values do not state effectiveness, conformity, or compliance.

observed_at.description: When the control event was observed. CA2 validates the calendar value; this is not legal time.

kind.description: The application is scoped to the Motus execution located by execution_ref. Retrieval and document validity do not verify that execution evidence.
